name: Ca thieu tam
summary: Cá thiều tẩm is seasoned dried fish in long yellow strips, salty-sweet, fragrant, and hot with pepper, eaten from the packet or grilled until chewy and soft. The same account calls it a freshwater fish and a Mekong Delta specialty, in pieces about two fingers across and in fish of about 4–7 kg.
origin: Da Nang strips seasoned with Nam Ô fish sauce, pepper, and white sugar. The fish is also called a Mekong Delta specialty.
texture: The strips are yellow, about 10–15 cm. Grilled, the meat is both chewy and soft.
taste: Sweet and fragrant when grilled, with a salty-sweet strip and the heat of pepper. Nam Ô fish sauce is the seasoning.
howToEat: Eat the strips from the packet, or grill them.
The fish is skinned, sliced thin, cut into pieces, mixed for about half an hour, and sun-dried from two days to a week depending on the sun, then cut into strips.
where: Supermarkets and specialty shops in Da Nang.
priceBand: A 250 g box is 100,000–120,000 đồng. A cooked plate is Check on arrival.
